component.name: Cera
component.summary: Write notes by hand and annotate PDFs

description.p: Cera is a light handwritten-notes app for Linux tablets with a stylus. Notes live as files in a folder of your choice, and PDFs become notes you can write on.

ul.li: Pressure-sensitive pen, highlighter, stroke eraser and lasso
Import PDFs and write over their pages; export back to PDF
A vault of folders and notes in the sidebar, with tabs
Ruled, grid and dotted paper; reorder, insert and delete pages
Palm rejection, pinch zoom and finger gestures
Small memory footprint and crash-safe autosave

description.p: First release: inking, vaults with tabs, PDF import and export, page sorter and lasso.
